title: DeepSeek Harness launches customizable AI agent platform
description: DeepSeek has launched DeepSeek Harness, a free, fully customizable AI framework that enables users to build custom AI agents from modular components. Unlike Claude Code, DeepSeek Harness treats every element—including the AI model, tools, memory, and agent loop—as interchangeable plugins, allowing seamless customization. It supports running with any AI model locally and can integrate sub-agents like Claude Code and Codex. The platform comes pre-equipped with 53 free, open-source tools, facilitating flexible development without additional costs. Its rapid adoption, demonstrated by 180,000 GitHub stars within a week, reflects a growing interest in modular and open AI architectures, offering developers significant control and scalability in AI agent creation. #DeepSeekHarness #ClaudeCode #OpenSourceAI #ModularAI #CustomAIAgents #AIFramework #GitHubStars #AIDevelopment #CodexIntegration #AIAgents #FreeAItools #LocalAI #AIplugins #DeepSeek #AIinnovation
